description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Workhorse.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering its undying ability and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Workhorse trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.
